comment: What civilizations see and remember (GDD 8.2, CORE simplified: oral memory; stage 3g). Every turn each lived-in settlement sees the cells within sightCells (hunters and gatherers roam far in a turn of decades). Scouts: every turn each lived-in settlement sends a scout in a random direction; it walks up to scoutCells over land and sea ice and sees the cells next to its way (GDD 8.2: what hunters and scouts see goes into memory). Oral memory: a cell seen once stays known for oralMemoryYears after it was last seen, then it is forgotten unless the tribe comes back (drawn maps from writing come with later eras). Journeys: a camp may set out for a known place up to journeyCells away; it walks maxMoveCells (population.json) per turn over known land, sea ice and land bridges.
